record.paper: Notes on Cops and Robber game on graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Notes on Cops and Robber game on graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Are the surfaces of constant curvature any simpler than general Riemannian surfaces with respect to the Cops and Robber game?
dossier_meta.context_text: The author asks whether the special geometric structure of constant-curvature surfaces (spherical, Euclidean, or hyperbolic) renders the continuous Cops and Robbers game more tractable than on general Riemannian surfaces.
